title: Star map
description: 20 000 stars around a galactic core. Hover one and it lights up, picked on the GPU in the same frame. Click to choose it, and a callout pins beside it with its name and distance from the core, typed out in MSDF text.
line: 20 000 stars. Hover one and the GPU picks it in the same frame.
hint: hover a star · click to choose · drag to orbit · wheel to zoom
